description: More than a year after publicly downplaying a spike in homicides by suggesting it could always be worse and dismissing gang violence was nothing new to Northeastern Pennsylvania, Mayor Paige Cognetti continues to approach public safety with the same dismissive posture, even as violent crime keeps piling up on her watch.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Rob for PA
title: Brutal Crimes Continue to Pile Up in Scranton as Mayor Cognetti Downplays Crime - Rob for PA
